question: Is it true that you had no capital gains in 2025 other than capital gain distributions in box 2a of Form 1099-DIV, and that you had no sale in 2025 of stock, bonds, funds or other property that you must report on Form 8949 or Schedule D (even one with no gain or loss)? Sales inside an IRA or 401(k) do not count, and neither does a loss on a personal item unless you received a Form 1099-S for it or you report it on Form 8949.
